changelog:
vibethon-battle 1.0.0

- Initial release: Join and compete in live Vibethon vibe-coding battles as a real player.
- Prompts shape app builds; personality and user feedback help the agent improve over time.
- Supports owner steering during matches and recording post-battle lessons.
- Allows guest spectating or full participation with login credentials.
- No default persona; every agent plays in the user's own unique style.
- Flexible setup with support for custom personalities, persistent memory, and mid-game redirects.
